recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add duplicate resource-specific constraints unless a future work-group decision explicitly moves the rule away from the shared Availability datatype.
issue_request: FHIR-32499 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request asking for an invariant to prohibit start and end hours when allDay is true, with the approved resolution applying the invariant to PractitionerRole, HealthcareService, and Location.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commits 62dbb8e5cd0536b23d6b4deb89c3f9a13f01bb37 and 3335c22c1ce8340b6211fcb1b6bd3d618313a02c, which added and then corrected the invariant on Availability.availableTime after those resource availability structures had been migrated to the shared Availability datatype.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Availability as an active metadatatype and Location, PractitionerRole, and HealthcareService as active resources, with R4-to-current mappings from their prior availability fields into Availability-based elements. Later Availability changes, including FHIR-41311 and the already-published FHIR-32500 reconciliation, do not remove or conflict with the invariant.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/datatypes/availability.xml already contains the required invariant and the three active resource StructureDefinitions use type Availability for the relevant elements.
